body:
Touches: `crates/core/src/local_paths/mod.rs`, `crates/core/src/local_paths/tests.rs`, `crates/runner/src/runner/triage/comment.rs`, `crates/runner/src/runner/triage/local.rs`, `crates/runner/src/runner/triage/facts.rs`, `crates/runner/src/runner/triage/scrub.rs` (new), `crates/runner/src/runner/triage/scrub_tests.rs` (new), `crates/runner/src/runner/triage/mod.rs`, `docs/design/triage-pass.md`

## What to build

A triage comment the local-path guard refuses is worded again and posted with the same text until the issue is given up. #1364 hit this 10 times, and kelpie could not triage this issue either, since its research quoted `/home/me`.

- The research's open questions and files are posted as written: `ask_comment` (`triage/local.rs`) puts them in the comment and in the prompt for the author's terminal, with the issue's title
- On a refused post, `send_triage` (`triage/comment.rs`) drops the body. The next poll asks the representative again, with no reason, and only its words change
- The guard reads `/home/me` as a path naming a user (`SYSTEM_PREFIXES` in `crates/core/src/local_paths/mod.rs`), while `scripts/check-private.sh` allows it

Two commits:

1. `fix(local_paths)`: `names_system_path` lets the placeholder `/home/me` through, alone or with a path under it. `/home/<name>` and every other name stay refused. `/Users/me` already passes, since only the given folders cover `/Users/`; pin it in a test.
2. `fix(triage)`: a new `triage/scrub.rs` checks each part of the research with `self.local.find(.., Surface::Prose)` before the words are asked for, as `ask.rs` and `ready.rs` already do for the bodies they write:
   - An open question or file that names this machine is left out of `found`, so it reaches neither the facts, the questions block nor the terminal prompt. The issue's title is left out of the terminal prompt the same way. Each one left out goes in the log as `triage #<n>: <count> questions left out, naming <leak>`, never the text itself
   - Words that still name this machine get one more wording call, with a facts line saying the last wording named `<leak>` (the `Leak` display text) and to leave it out. A second refusal goes to `triage_failed` as today
   - When the forge refuses a post anyway, `send_triage` keeps the `Leak` in `Tries`, and the next wording call is told the same way. If the same body would be posted again, it is not posted: the failure counts and the body is dropped
   - `comment.rs` is at 928 lines, so new code goes in `scrub.rs`, and `comment.rs` only calls it

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `local_paths::tests`: `/home/me`, `/home/me/x` and `/Users/me/x` pass as prose. `/home/<name>/x` and `/home/<other>/x` are refused
- [ ] `triage::scrub_tests` through the rig: a research question naming `/home/me` is posted as written
- [ ] `triage::scrub_tests`: a question naming a real home folder is left out, the comment posts on the first try with the other questions, and the log names the count and no path
- [ ] `triage::scrub_tests`: a title naming a home folder is left out of the terminal prompt, and the comment posts
- [ ] `triage::scrub_tests`: a representative stand-in whose first words name a home folder is called once more with the reason in its facts, and its clean second words are posted
- [ ] `triage::scrub_tests`: a forge stand-in that refuses a post leads to a wording call that carries the reason, and no body is posted twice
- [ ] `docs/design/triage-pass.md` says how a refused part is left out and the reason is passed on
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --lib local_paths`, `cargo test --lib runner::triage`, `scripts/file-size.sh` and `python3 scripts/doc-length.py` pass

title: fix(triage): a refused triage comment is retried as is, and the guard refuses /home/me
